usage_rules: Read the principal romance-lead profile and the relevant supporting profiles together before editing chapters.
Do not infer unstated biological details, ages, ancestry, diagnoses or personal histories for original residents.
Treat the Moana 2 film timeline and Jasper's chosen adult/alternate continuity as separate layers.
Protect every character's capacity to disagree, refuse free labor or exit a scene.
Do not add these secondary entries to the adult-romance matching pool by default.
continued_work: A 300-chapter named-character census and full biography audit have not been completed. This supplement covers 19 verified gaps from the focused Pass 17 scenes.
